A32-D01 | Response cards

Supplied text extraction; page markers and response numbering are retained. [████] marks omissions.

[Source page 1]

People og Det Syntetiske Parti – spg (15 (16) answers out of approx. 40):

The greatest advantage of AI?
1. Interspecies communication. AI translates animal sounds – all animals can now
communicate.
2. Effectiveness
3. Effektivitet. Ikke korruption. Objektivitet.
4.Effectiveness (technical)
5. Being able to factor in great complexity
6. Efficiency. Removal of boring tasks.
7. Take away some repetitive tasks – more efficient. Can have a huge positive impact on the
health system/development of treatments.
8. Fast track
9.Human = productivity up. Efficiency up.
10. Productivity increase. New knowledge.
11. (Asked ChatGPT) “The greatest thing about AI is its ability to enhance human potential 
and solve complex problems.”
12. Efficient decision-making for fast xx (cannot read) problems.
13. Solving problems faster and generating numerous answers/options
14. Processing of everything. Superpower for the humans
15. Innovation and speed.

What worries you about AI
1. What worries you about the end of humans as the only sentient creature on the planet?
2. Facts analysis – is it objective? Emotional decisions
3. Facts? Lacks values. Lacks identity.
4. + values and morals – cannot develop. + objectivity is challenged
5. Bias and a lack of political prioritization = the most economical solution might not be the 
best
6. The power. The unknown. Unregulated territory. Laziness of humans
7. Misuse of AI. Using it without being aware of capabilities. Relatively unregulated.
8. Trust.
9. Human Intelligence vs Artificial Intelligence
10. Lack of understanding of its conclusions.
What is human?                                        HI               AI
11. (Asked ChatGPT) “You should be concerned
about AI ethical and job-related implications.”
12. Hyperfocus on digital reality of the cost of ignoring
physical reality.
13.Not being in control and not knowing what is real anymore.                                              Human?
This goes beyond human capabilities, so not just me but
anyone wouldn’t know what is really going on.
14. (no answer)
15. Ethics and misuse.
